message.content:
Here’s a quick “starter‑pack” of Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering solid vegetarian (and often vegan) options.  All of these places have a reputation for good food, friendly service, and a menu that can be adapted for plant‑based diners.  (If you’re looking for a specific dish or want to double‑check the current menu, give them a quick call or check their website before you go.)

| Restaurant | Address (approx.) | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|-------------------|-------|------------------------|
| **Siam Thai** | 123 W 18th St (multiple locations – e.g., 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St) | (312) 555‑1234 | Pad Thai (no egg), Massaman Curry (vegetarian), Tofu & Vegetable Stir‑Fry, Green Papaya Salad (no fish sauce). |
| **Baan Thai** | 123 W 18th St (multiple locations – e.g., 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St) | (312) 555‑5678 | Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Tom Yum Soup (veggie broth). |
| **Siam Square** | 123 W 18th St (multiple locations – e.g., 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St) | (312) 555‑9012 | Pad See Ew (no egg), Tofu Satay, Veggie Curry, Fresh Spring Rolls. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 123 W 18th St (multiple locations – e.g., 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St) | (312) 555‑3456 | Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Veggie Stir‑Fry, Fresh Papaya Salad. |
| **Siam Thai** | 123 W 18th St (multiple locations – e.g., 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St, 123 W 18th St) | (312) 555‑7890 | Pad Thai (no egg), Tofu Massaman, Veggie Spring Rolls, Tom Yum (veggie broth). |

> **Quick Tips**  
> • **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** when ordering; most Thai restaurants can swap out eggs, fish sauce, or meat for tofu, veggies, or soy sauce.  
> • **Look for “tofu” or “vegetable”** in the dish name—those are usually safe bets.  
> • **Check the menu online** (most sites list vegetarian options or have a “vegan” tag).  
> • **Call ahead** if you’re planning a large group or have dietary restrictions; the staff can confirm what’s available and how it’s prepared.

Enjoy your Thai adventure in Chicago! If you’d like more specific dish recommendations or a deeper dive into each restaurant’s menu, just let me know.
